description: This PHP class defines the PayGradeModel used in the OrangeHRM system's API layer. It serializes PayGrade entities into an array suitable for API responses, including associated currencies with their IDs and names.

classes.name: PayGradeModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes PayGrade objects into a structured array for API responses, including associated currencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PayGrade entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the PayGrade entity into an array with its ID, name, and associated currencies (with ID and name).
